claims.evidence: Each of 100 RAW claimed 3 times (light/medium/heavy). Excluded: 20131201_VSQ_q9_35_112817r_BSA50fmol_IPCYLD_4.raw (BSA 50 fmol QC injection, not a cell sample, though MaxQuant processed it in SILAC2).
summary.txt/mqpar: multiplicity 3, Labels0 empty, Labels1 Arg6;Lys4, Labels2 Arg10;Lys8 in every sub-experiment; companion record describes Arg0/Lys0, Arg6/Lys4, Arg10/Lys8 media.
Identifier invented by annotator from the MaxQuant Experiment column (SILAC1-4) of the ExpDesign files and the channel. It carries no biological meaning.
Title and PRIDE protocol: HeLa cells; PRIDE organism NEWT:9606. Age/sex are Cellosaurus HeLa values (sdrf-tools cellline lookup), not per-deposit. HeLa clone/subline not stated.
Tissue of origin of HeLa (Cellosaurus); PRIDE organismPart is only 'HeLa cell'.

claims.value: Q Exactive (IP, StUbEx); Orbitrap Velos Pro (pull-down)
claims.evidence: RAW header strings 'Q Exactive' and 'Orbitrap Velos Pro MS'; PRIDE lists 'LTQ Orbitrap Velos' (raw wins). summary.txt Instrument=Q Exactive for IP and StUbEx.

mqpar.xml fixed Carbamidomethyl (C); variable Oxidation (M), Acetyl (Protein N-term), Deamidation (NQ); + Phospho (STY) for IP and StUbEx; + GlyGly (K) for StUbEx. Pull-down has no Phospho/GlyGly search; padded with 'not applicable' to keep column counts equal.

claims.location: comment[precursor mass tolerance], comment[fragment mass tolerance]
claims.evidence: mqpar mainSearchTol 6; parameters.txt MS/MS tol FTMS 20 ppm, ITMS 0.5 Da; combined/allSpectra files are HCD.FTMS (IP, StUbEx) and CID.ITMS (pull-down).

claims.value: HCD + orbitrap (IP, StUbEx); CID + ion trap (pull-down)
claims.evidence: allSpectra.<fragmentation>.<analyzer> file names in each search zip.

claims.value: Trypsin (all); Lys-C second column for StUbEx
claims.evidence: PRIDE protocol: ubiquitinome digested with LysC and Trypsin; IP and pull-down in-gel trypsin. MaxQuant searched Trypsin/P.
Protocol: bead-bound proteins resolved on SDS-PAGE and in-gel digested (IP, pull-down); StUbEx peptides 'fractionated through a pH gradient' (method not specific enough).
IP 1-12 and pull-down 1-16 are the numeric suffixes; StUbEx suffix order 10,20,25,30,35,40,55,70,80,B,FT follows the deposited ExpDesign listing, not a verified elution order.
Companion protocol: top 12 data-dependent; MaxQuant DDA search.

claims.value: IP 1-2, PD 1-2 (MaxQuant experiment number); StUbEx SILAC1/2 = 1, SILAC3/4 = 2
claims.evidence: StUbEx file names: UBI_1/UBI_2 (20131214) vs Rep2-Ubi / Rep2-Ubi_S2 (20140304); interpretation, not stated explicitly.

Disease of the tissue the HeLa line derives from (Cellosaurus: HPV-related endocervical adenocarcinoma; PRIDE disease: cervix carcinoma); companion protocol: 'cervix epithelial adenocarcinoma HeLa cells'.

claims.value: IP: L = CYLD-deficient (treatment not available), M = wild type untreated, H = wild type + EGF. StUbEx SILAC2/4: L = CYLD-deficient untreated, M = control shRNA + EGF, H = control shRNA untreated. StUbEx SILAC1/3: L = CYLD-deficient untreated, M = control shRNA + EGF, H = CYLD-deficient + EGF. Pull-down: L = beads only; M/H = unphosphorylated vs Tyr15-phosphorylated CYLD peptide, swapped between replicates (rep1 M=unphos, H=pY15; rep2 M=pY15, H=unphos).
claims.evidence: Paper design (Fig. 3A, Fig. 2A, pull-down Methods) as reported by independent reviewer round 2; NOT re-read by the producer (PMC blocked for the producer). Producer re-verified from deposited proteinGroups.txt: IP CYLD M/L 28.6 and 16.3, H/L 30.2 and 16.4, H/M ~1.0 (light = CYLD-deficient); pull-down CBLB/UBASH3B/CHST3 H/M 6.6/7.1/8.4 in SILAC1 vs 0.16/0.13/0.12 in SILAC2 (bait swap); StUbEx xlsx renamed ratio columns for SILAC2/4. Medium/heavy untreated-vs-EGF assignments in IP and SILAC1/3 rest on the paper text. 'EGF' = 150 ng/ml, 6 min after 16 h starvation per reviewer (not encoded).

limitations: Paper full text was not retrievable by the producer (PMC bot check); design assignments for IP, StUbEx SILAC1/3 and pull-down come from the round-2 reviewer's reading of PMC5546196 plus deposited proteinGroups cross-checks, and should be spot-checked by a human.
Pull-down cell source unconfirmed: design file is named ExpDesign_PullDown_hMSCs.txt, companion record mentions Skov3/Hep2; HeLa assumed (cell line cannot be a reserved word under cell-lines).
Deposited mqpar differs from paper text (precursor 6 vs 7 ppm; Phospho searched in IP and StUbEx per mqpar vs IP and pull-down per paper); deposited files followed.
Reduction/alkylation reagents not stated; Carbamidomethyl is Fixed in the deposited search.
BSA50fmol QC raw file excluded (processed in IP MaxQuant SILAC2).
StUbEx fraction order (10..80,B,FT) follows the deposited ExpDesign listing.
EGF dose/time and starvation not encoded; HeLa subline/passage/medium not stated.
